title: The Effect of Location of Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation on Postoperative Opioid Analgesic Requirement: Acupoint Versus Nonacupoint Stimulation
analyzed: All100 completed protocol;25 per arm, p3 Results and p4 Table1.
modality: Group IV TEAS; GroupsII/III nonacupoint TENS
selected_comparison: GroupIV acupoint vs GroupI sham. Do not combine dermatomal/nonacupoint arms as TEAS.

rob_source.D1: Random assignment stated p2; sequence mechanism and concealment not reported; Table1 not suggestive of failed randomization.

rob_source.D5: No prospective registry/protocol/SAP. Multiple pain measurements and selected sedation summary with pain values absent; distinguish missing result from proven selection of opioid result.
